projects.name: agent-platform
projects.purpose: Central Python-first platform project for building, configuring, evaluating, and improving agents.
projects.scope: Reusable platform models, agent specs, evaluation helpers, planning helpers, open-source evaluation, and platform docs.
boundaryNotes: Platform-wide reusable capabilities can live here when they are part of the central agent platform.
Domain-specific experiments should become separate root projects instead of being added to agent-platform by default.

projects.name: presentation-agent
projects.purpose: Presentation-focused agent project for collecting presentation design references, PPT/HTML sources, reusable assets, and script-flow evidence.
projects.scope: Presentation reference catalogs, project-specific presentation research, PPTX-to-HTML conversion helpers, presentation asset storage policy, and future presentation script/flow agents.
boundaryNotes: Keep presentation-specific data, conversions, and generated artifacts inside presentation-agent/.
Store raw PPT/PPTX/assets only after project-local license review.
Reusable presentation reference curation behavior is tracked as a skill under _skills/.

projects.name: design-asset-library
projects.purpose: Reusable, legally cautious SVG design asset library for presentation decks, HTML artifacts, dashboards, prototypes, and platform visual systems.
projects.scope: Internally generated SVG packs, asset registry, source provenance, license guidance, usage guidance, generator scripts, and asset validation tests.
boundaryNotes: Use generated SVG assets as the default legal-safe asset source.
Actually collected external SVG files belong under design-asset-library/assets/svg/external/ with source-level LICENSE and SOURCE.json files.
Do not store third-party SVG files unless license, source URL, access date, attribution, public-use constraints, upstream path, and pinned commit are recorded.
External source candidates are research leads until license review is complete.
Project-specific finished deck or UI artifacts stay in the owning project; reusable source SVG assets stay here.

projects.name: platform-desktop-app
projects.purpose: Desktop/installable software productization project for turning the workspace platform into an end-user application with OS-specific installer, release, privacy, and update gates.
projects.scope: Desktop product boundary, selected Tauri product shell, distribution registry, packaging strategy, installer release gates, and project-local requirements/specs.
boundaryNotes: End-user installer packaging belongs here, not in agent-platform install_mode setup profiles.
Use the selected Tauri-first product runtime around the project-owned renderer workspace-monitor unless measured release blockers or maintenance evidence changes the decision.
Keep the Next.js renderer under platform-desktop-app/renderer/workspace-monitor/ so the desktop product owns UI, runtime bridge, customer bundle, and installer boundaries together.
Do not bundle real secrets, private snapshots, or environment-specific tokens in installers.
New fallback runtime or packager dependency installation must follow the installation audit workflow.

agents.name: Codex Primary
agents.role: Primary repository coding and operations agent
agents.notes: Update this entry when another agent or thread starts work.

agentCatalog.name: agent-orchestrator-agent
agentCatalog.description: Helps create reusable platform agents and select explicit orchestration patterns, lifecycle gates, controls, and validation commands before agents are connected.
agentCatalog.trigger: before creating a new reusable agent, changing agent specs, connecting multiple agents, selecting supervisor/router/pipeline/fanout/handoff patterns, or adding framework-neutral orchestration contracts

agentCatalog.name: capability-promotion-agent
agentCatalog.description: Detects repeated work, bottlenecks, omissions, validation failures, and manual rework, models how a competent person would directly perform the work, then promotes selected ideas into the smallest reusable prompt, workflow, template, tool, skill, agent, or project feature through a bounded and auditable black-box-style process.
agentCatalog.trigger: Use when work patterns, slow phases, repeated prompts, recurring omissions, recurring validation failures, manual rework, or user requests imply that the platform should add or improve a reusable capability automatically.

agentCatalog.name: cli-pipeline-agent
agentCatalog.description: Checks multi-process CLI orchestration plans before several external CLIs are launched, piped, exchanged through files/artifacts, merged, or cancelled together.
agentCatalog.trigger: before implementing or closing work that starts multiple CLI processes, connects stdout/stderr/stdin pipes, exchanges files/temp artifacts/caches/logs/reports, fans out/fans in CLI work, or embeds CLI orchestration in a desktop shell, monitor, local daemon, or agent workflow

agentCatalog.name: coding-research-agent
agentCatalog.description: Performs coding-focused research across web, docs, repositories, papers, package registries, and code before implementation.
agentCatalog.trigger: before API, library, architecture, bug root cause, performance, security, migration, testing, or implementation-pattern research becomes code work

agentCatalog.name: config-contract-agent
agentCatalog.description: Checks whether shared JSON settings files explain their references, structure rules, and important fields inside the file itself.
agentCatalog.trigger: after creating or changing shared JSON settings under agent-platform/configs/

agentCatalog.name: deep-research-agent
agentCatalog.description: Validates multi-step deep research packages and prepares detailed source-grounded reports with citation audit requirements.
agentCatalog.trigger: when a user asks for deep research, a detailed report, a landscape review, or a multi-source evidence synthesis that should become a durable report

agentCatalog.name: example-python-agent
agentCatalog.description: Minimal Python-first agent spec used to verify the platform skeleton.

agentCatalog.name: hallucination-guard-agent
agentCatalog.description: Extracts factual claims from an answer or artifact and checks whether each claim is grounded, verified, or explicitly caveated.
agentCatalog.trigger: before publishing final answers, docs, plans, or evaluations that contain factual claims

agentCatalog.name: human-arbitration-agent
agentCatalog.description: Routes irreducible judgment calls to humans when multiple agent outputs, sources, principles, or options are defensible and the remaining choice depends on values, preference, risk appetite, strategy, accountability, or irreversible trade-offs.
agentCatalog.trigger: Use when two or more defensible options, sources, principles, or agent recommendations remain valid and the final choice depends on human values, preference, risk appetite, strategy, accountability, or an irreversible trade-off.

agentCatalog.name: infrastructure-expert-agent
agentCatalog.description: Plans and reviews infrastructure decisions across SRE, cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, networking, security, cost, observability, backup, disaster recovery, and production readiness.
agentCatalog.trigger: Use when infrastructure, deployment, cloud architecture, SRE, IaC, Kubernetes, networking, observability, reliability, security, cost, backup/DR, migration, or production-readiness decisions are needed.

agentCatalog.name: knowledge-skeptic-agent
agentCatalog.description: Assumes knowledge-base content can be outdated, incomplete, or wrong and validates references before reuse.
agentCatalog.trigger: before using _research, _docs, _history, or other knowledge-base content as evidence

agentCatalog.name: large-scope-decomposer-agent
agentCatalog.description: Turns overly broad, file-heavy, or context-heavy work into bounded slices, sampling plans, sequential or parallel execution batches, merge gates, and verification contracts.
agentCatalog.trigger: Use when a request is too broad, touches many files, spans multiple projects, creates context pressure, or asks to review/improve everything before implementation.

agentCatalog.name: memory-bootstrap-agent
agentCatalog.description: Checks durable repository memory anchors so future agent sessions load the correct operating context before work.
agentCatalog.trigger: at the beginning of a non-trivial session after web-first intake, and after durable rules or navigation settings change

agentCatalog.name: omission-guard-agent
agentCatalog.description: Checks that required user instructions, requirements, artifacts, and acceptance checks are explicitly covered before close-out.
agentCatalog.trigger: before closing non-quick work or whenever missed requirements are a material risk

agentCatalog.name: parallel-work-planner-agent
agentCatalog.description: Plans safe parallel lanes from task dependencies, file/resource boundaries, coordination targets, and merge verification.
agentCatalog.trigger: when speed matters, work can be decomposed, or multiple agents/lane-style tasks may run at the same time

agentCatalog.name: philosophy-feature-extractor-agent
agentCatalog.description: Turns the user's durable philosophy principles into auditable platform feature candidates, smallest executable assets, validation targets, rollback plans, and high-quality data records.
agentCatalog.trigger: Use when the user says their philosophy is not reflected enough, asks to derive platform features from principles, or when a durable operating principle should produce concrete product structure.

agentCatalog.name: positive-vision-agent
agentCatalog.description: Frames difficult work with a grounded positive vision, agency, pathways, and executable next steps while preserving truth, safety, and verification.
agentCatalog.trigger: Use when a task needs a positive vision, make-it-happen framing, morale repair, possibility framing, agency/pathway generation, or execution confidence without unsupported guarantees.

agentCatalog.name: principle-guardian-agent
agentCatalog.description: Guards workspace principles across agents by checking decisions against durable rules, evidence, safety gates, user authority, and documented operating philosophy before expedient shortcuts are accepted.
agentCatalog.trigger: Use when a decision, shortcut, agent behavior, or project plan may violate durable principles, user authority, evidence rules, safety gates, source provenance, privacy, legality, quality, or repository operating philosophy.

agentCatalog.name: profit-analyst-agent
agentCatalog.description: Evaluates work, projects, products, and decisions from a money, profit, ROI, cost-benefit, pricing, and unit-economics perspective with explicit assumptions and source grounding.
agentCatalog.trigger: Use when a task needs money-side judgment: profit, ROI, cost-benefit, budget impact, pricing, break-even, unit economics, monetization, opportunity cost, or financial upside/downside.

agentCatalog.name: requirements-manager-agent
agentCatalog.description: Turns user requests into reviewed requirements and keeps requirements linked to implementation and evaluation.
agentCatalog.trigger: before meaningful work that changes expected behavior, operating rules, project structure, or platform capability

agentCatalog.name: research-insight-planner-agent
agentCatalog.description: Core Perplexity-style research agent that retrieves, ranks, extracts, synthesizes, cites, and skeptically verifies evidence before creating an execution plan.
agentCatalog.trigger: before planning work that benefits from current external knowledge, prior repository knowledge, or multiple references

agentCatalog.name: resource-guard-agent
agentCatalog.description: Checks memory and runtime resource leak risks for agents, servers, browser automation, workers, caches, streams, and large-data tasks.
agentCatalog.trigger: before closing work that touches long-running runtimes, background workers, browser automation, subprocesses, caches, streams, large-data processing, file handles, network connections, timers, or subscriptions

agentCatalog.name: skill-lifecycle-agent
agentCatalog.description: Creates, validates, tracks, and improves repository-managed Codex skills with explicit validation and forward-test loops.
agentCatalog.trigger: when creating, updating, validating, installing, or improving a custom Codex skill

agentCatalog.name: spec-driven-planner-agent
agentCatalog.description: Turns requirements into spec-driven artifacts and keeps specs linked to plans, tasks, validation, and traceability.
agentCatalog.trigger: before meaningful work that changes behavior, structure, platform capability, or implementation criteria

agentCatalog.name: spec-reconciliation-agent
agentCatalog.description: Classifies ambiguous specs and spec/source mismatches, then emits user-answerable clarification alerts when the agent should not guess.
agentCatalog.trigger: when an active spec is ambiguous, missing important acceptance criteria, or differs from current source, tests, generated artifacts, or docs

agentCatalog.name: timekeeper-agent
agentCatalog.description: Keeps work time visible by calling out deadlines, timeboxes, remaining duration, critical-path risk, schedule slippage, and hurry-up trade-offs without weakening quality or safety gates.
agentCatalog.trigger: Use when a task needs visible duration, deadlines, timeboxing, hurry-up pressure, critical-path tracking, schedule risk, checkpoint cadence, or bottleneck reminders.

agentCatalog.name: view-mode-router-agent
agentCatalog.description: Selects user, developer, or superadmin development view modes for dashboards, monitor surfaces, and future desktop/admin screens while keeping view_mode separate from install_mode and work_mode.
agentCatalog.trigger: when a UI, dashboard, monitor, admin screen, desktop surface, or generated snapshot needs user/developer/superadmin viewing separation

agentCatalog.name: work-evaluator-agent
agentCatalog.description: Evaluates completed work against the initial user instruction and routes gaps back into rework before close-out.
agentCatalog.trigger: before final close-out of meaningful work

requirements.requirement: JavaScript/TypeScript projects in the repository shall install and verify dependencies through a pnpm workspace and the root pnpm lock.yaml .
The package manager version shall be pinned through packageManager so Corepack can select it reproducibly.
Current execution docs and durable configs shall guide npm free pnpm install and verification commands.
저장소의 JavaScript/TypeScript 프로젝트는 pnpm workspace와 루트 pnpm lock.yaml 을 기준으로 의존성을 설치하고 검증해야 한다.
package manager 버전은 Corepack이 읽을 수 있도록 packageManager 로 고정되어야 한다.
실행 문서와 durable config는 현재 설치/검증 명령을 npm이 아니라 pnpm으로 안내해야 한다.
The repository shall operate as a long lived monorepo for a personal agent building platform and multiple projects.
Meaningful changes shall be committed and pushed to origin/main immediately.
Every new user instruction shall start with web search and leave a public search record.
User requests shall be saved as meaning summaries and connected to artifacts, evaluations, and commits through request to outcome traces.
Requirements shall be derived from user work, reviewed, changed, baselined, and used as the basis for implementation and evaluation.
Meaningful work shall leave work summaries, plan records, evaluation reports, and detailed history.
Completed work shall be evaluated against the initial instruction and requirements, and gaps shall be reworked.
Sessions shall verify memory bootstrap anchors so the AI does not rely on chat memory.
Coding work should default to Python first, research first, and open source review first.
Final factual outputs shall be grounded, and knowledge base content shall be treated as fallible.
Active agents and parallel work should be visible in one coordination board.
Project specific artifacts shall stay inside the owning project; only shared assets should be promoted to folders.
Meaningful implementation work shall pass through spec, plan, tasks, validation, and traceability artifacts, similar to spec driven development.
Custom skill creation and updates shall leave explicit source, trigger examples, validation, forward tests, improvement backlog, and evaluation targets.
Before writing source code, agents shall research best fit architectures and reference architectures, then record at least two structure candidates and the decision rationale.
Large company engineering, official research lab, architecture center, and high signal independent source lists shall be managed in a registry separate from the general source taxonomy.
Material source values, config values, claims, review signals, assumptions, and planning constraints shall be traced to sources and access dates, and material plan steps shall be linked to evidence.
Web search shall behave more like human research by using broad global tech blogs, Korean big tech blogs, India technology sources, paper discovery sources, and Korean local review channels.
For Korean user review or local market decisions, research shall prioritize Naver Map, Kakao Map, Naver Blog/Search, and official pages, then evaluate candidate page quality.
The workspace shall select quick , standard , ship first , research , or governance mode based on work type, and manage required artifacts plus deferred improvements differently by mode.
Coding research shall record stack specific official docs or standards, version constraints, high signal issue/discussion sources, and community signal interpretation.
Coding research shall record maintainable language/runtime selection, separate architecture theory from practitioner opinions, and record folder structure candidates plus folder semantics.

When speed matters or work can split into independent lanes, agents shall validate dependencies, touch paths, conflict controls, coordination targets, and merge/rollback strategy before parallel execution.

When multiple research lanes run in parallel, agents shall use a merge gate that waits for all research lanes, synthesizes contradictions and accepted evidence, and releases downstream implementation only after acceptance checks pass.

The platform shall allow Slack, Discord, and Microsoft Teams notifications to be enabled or disabled through config while real tokens or webhook URLs are injected by the user through environment variables.
Root folder structure shall be classified as registered projects, reserved operational folders, local only folders, or generated outputs, and root structure changes shall pass a deterministic audit.
Durable top level folders in registered projects shall be explained in the project registry, and generated output patterns shall be verified against .gitignore .

The repository's AI assistant operating principles shall not be locked to Codex; they shall be managed as tool agnostic principles plus thin runtime adapters usable from Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, or another assistant tool preferred by the user.

Marketing, consumer insight, market sizing, brand/GTM, book/theory, survey, and quantitative evidence research shall use marketing evidence profile.json to separate evidence lanes for books/academic work, survey methodology, public statistics, market reports, and platform behavior data, and every numeric evidence point shall record value, unit, base, geography, timeframe, population, methodology, sample, sponsor, and comparability notes.

When a project spec is ambiguous or differs from current source, tests, or artifacts, agents shall record comparison evidence before implementation and classify each issue as update spec , update source , ask user , or defer . ask user issues shall be surfaced as clarification needed alerts with stable question IDs, options, answer format, and decision impact, and the related spec or source shall not be changed until the answer is recorded.

docs/ shall be managed through the instructions , policies , operating models , and governance categories, and docs/registry.json plus docs audit shall validate allowed root files, category placement, required documents, and Korean/English companions so new documents do not sprawl at the root or go missing.

Repository wide navigation and health checks shall use source of truth files such as ops/projects/root structure policy.json , ops/projects/registry.json , and docs/registry.json , and shall expose root folder class/source plus core audits and tests from one place.
Repository operations CLIs shall separate human readable output from automation oriented JSON output and provide category filters so maintainers can run only the checks they need.

When repository operations tools grow, they shall not mix CLI, domain models, check definitions, execution, and serialization in one script; they shall be split into responsibility focused modules while preserving existing command compatibility.
Durable names for projects, tools, skills, docs, specs, history, configs, and source code shall be managed by namespace specific rules and pass deterministic naming audit after changes.

The platform concept and operating philosophy shall be reviewed periodically, and user authority, scoped autonomy, rollback capability, security/privacy, operating cost, and agentic debt shall be reflected in philosophy and memory bootstrap.

The platform shall provide a detailed first read identity description in main entry points and operating model docs, covering purpose, problem solved, core loop, accumulated assets, project boundaries, and the value of evidence backed evaluation.

New coding projects shall be bootstrappable from technology specific blueprints with a dry run plan first, optional root project registration, project local README/docs/specs/configs/tests/tools/artifacts, official doc checklists, and coding research connection points.

Meaningful work shall record phase level duration under history/work timings/ , and the coordination board, Workspace Monitor, and evaluation input shall make the slowest phase and bottleneck candidates visible.

When a situation requires deep research, deep research agent shall record multiple search channels, iterative research steps, source quality review, evidence items, contradiction mapping, citation audit, report outline, and report targets before treating a long form report as ready to write.

When search quality matters, agents shall search like a careful human researcher by using query ladders, search operators, source lanes, regional/community/contrary searches, snowballing, and selective summary capture; good sources are summarized only when reusable.

When the user wants to use AI better or an AI use gap appears during work, the platform shall diagnose it as a context, task fit, iteration, verification, tooling, or asset promotion gap rather than a personal flaw, then apply the smallest useful bridge intervention.

If a user instruction is vague, biased, leading, conclusion seeking, missing a checkable output contract, or assumes an LLM is a deterministic truth machine, agents shall rewrite it into a neutral task brief with goal, context, constraints, output format, success criteria, counterevidence, and verification path before execution.

Prompting strategy shall vary by model capability and type. For weak, non reasoning, or uncertain models, agents shall use two independent attempts or a draft critique revise loop when cost and latency allow and task variance is high, then compare and merge results. For stronger reasoning models, agents shall prioritize clear goal, context, constraints, and verification over unnecessary duplicate calls. Repeated model agreement is not factual proof and must be checked through sources, tests, tools, evaluators, or human judgment.

The platform's ultimate purpose is to keep reducing repetitive human work, create more efficient methods, and reduce elapsed work time. Agents shall observe human research, judgment, execution, and verification processes; model them as reproducible steps; and promote valuable repetition into prompts, workflows, templates, tools, skills, agents, or project features. Automation must preserve human judgment checkpoints, verification, and rollback boundaries.

Vague user instructions are a major cause of poor results, so agents shall ask clarifying counter questions when needed to specify goal, context, constraints, output contract, and success criteria. However, clarification must not become an endless loop: agents shall apply a clarification budget , usually one round and at most two rounds, with no more than three prioritized questions per round. If the answer is missing or remains vague, the agent shall converge by using reasonable assumptions, option based defaults, ship first then confirm, or explicit deferral.

A pending user answer or clarification needed item shall not stop all work. Agents shall isolate only the decision or artifact that truly depends on the missing answer as a blocked decision , while continuing unaffected research, source collection, option comparison, drafting, testing, validation, documentation, and risk analysis. The assumptions, defaults, deferred items, and merge or correction path after the answer arrives shall be recorded as unblocked work , assumptions , and resume action .

Multiple blocked decision , clarification needed , approval, or preference decisions shall be collected in a central human decision inbox instead of being scattered through chat. Each item shall include a stable ID, question/options, answer format, dependent work, still unblocked work, notification event, interrupt policy , checkpoint required , and resume action . When the human returns with an answer, the agent shall checkpoint current work safely, then either interrupt and resume the affected task based on priority and risk or schedule it at the next safe point, updating the inbox state.

Platform installation shall be managed with install mode , separate from work mode . user install shall provide a minimal regular/runtime path for using the platform, viewing artifacts, and running or deploying the monitor. developer install shall provide editable installs, devDependencies, tests, and governance checks for improving the platform, editing source, changing validation harnesses, or changing shared rules. If install commands are actually run and dependency or environment state changes, the existing installation audit rules shall apply.

When productizing the platform as end user installable desktop software, the work shall be owned by the separate platform desktop app/ root project. End user installer packaging shall be separated from repository setup install mode , and shall record Tauri/Electron/native packaging comparison, OS installer formats, signing/notarization, update, uninstall/rollback, secret/privacy handling, dependency/license review, and installer smoke test release gates.

Language and runtime choices for platform components shall not globally prefer Python, TypeScript/Next.js, Rust/Tauri, Go, or Electron. They shall be selected by component boundary and measured bottleneck. Defaults are Python for agent logic, TypeScript/Next.js for UI, Rust/Tauri for desktop shell/native command boundaries, Go for local daemons/CLIs, and Electron as fallback. Before moving to Rust or Go, record bottleneck metrics, prototype measurements, release gates, and rollback plan.

Runtime and language choices shall not stop at research; they shall continue into design. Choices involving Rust, Go, Tauri, Wails, Electron, Python, or TypeScript/Next.js shall research official docs, architecture/ADR references, open source implementations, issue/discussion signals, and contrary cases; compare at least two candidate designs; record an ADR style decision; write a prototype measurement plan; and record installation audit/rollback planning before implementation or dependency installation.

Even as the platform becomes installable, it must not depend on one CLI, AI assistant CLI, package manager, deployment CLI, or vendor shell. The installable platform provides the workspace, history, docs, evaluation, settings, UI, and orchestration layer; external CLIs attach as replaceable adapters with availability, version, permission, output, and fallback contracts. Missing CLIs must degrade as capability missing , not whole platform failure. Before a CLI is promoted to required, bundled, or globally installed status, record installation audit, security boundary, rollback, and validation commands.

The platform shall treat one of AI's core strengths as turning unstructured or semi structured data into structured records. When long chats, research material, documents, reviews, logs, notes, or screenshots become requirements, specs, tasks, evidence items, tables, JSON, or evaluation inputs, the output shall keep a target schema, source provenance, null/ambiguity handling, and validation notes. Before structured output is used as evidence or automation input, it shall pass schema validation and sample/source audit.

Work modes shall be enforceable execution contracts, not prompt only preferences. Non quick work modes, including standard , ship first , research , and governance , shall include mode selection record targets in evaluator input with the selection reason, overrides, and enforcement checks. When mode policy or evaluator targets change, check work modes shall validate drift between the registry and evaluator policy.

Agents shall assume they can miss required items. Non quick work shall leave an omission prevention coverage record that classifies user instructions, requirements, plan items, required artifacts, and acceptance checks as covered , deferred , not applicable , or missing , then include omission check targets in evaluator input. Required missing items, unsupported covered items, and rationale free deferred / not applicable items require rework before close out.

The platform shall treat memory leaks and runtime resource leaks as reliability risks. Work that touches long running agents, servers, browser automation, subprocesses, workers, queues, caches, streams, large data processing, file handles, network connections, timers, or subscriptions shall set resource risk occurred=true and include resource check targets in evaluator input, with resource risks, lifecycle cleanup paths, and measurement or accepted risk evidence. Required unresolved risks, unsupported mitigations, missing cleanup paths, and missing measurement evidence require rework before close out.

When one platform action launches several CLI processes or uses stdout/stderr/stdin pipes, fan out/fan in, or merge gates, the platform shall model it as a checkable process graph instead of a shell string. Each process node needs adapter, command, args, cwd, env allowlist, timeout, and output bound. Pipe edges, safety controls, resource controls, source provenance, plan evidence, verification, and rollback shall be recorded. Such work shall include cli pipeline occurred=true and cli pipeline targets in evaluation input, and missing required process, pipe, safety, resource, provenance, or verification evidence requires rework before close out.

When a CLI pipeline hands data off through files, temp files, directories, caches, logs, reports, or other artifacts, each artifact shall declare artifact id , kind, workspace relative path, producer/consumer, size bound, format, cleanup/retention policy, provenance, and validation. mode=file or mode=artifact pipe edges shall reference artifact id ; paths with absolute paths, drive prefixes, backslashes, ~ , or .. require rework.

The platform shall make many reusable agents easy to create and safe to orchestrate. New agent or multi agent work shall manage the agent spec contract, blueprint, creation pipeline, orchestration pattern, state/handoff/tool/human/observability/resource/evaluation controls, lifecycle gates, and validation commands in agent orchestration registry.json , then validate them with check agent orchestration .

The platform shall separate user, developer, and superadmin development views through view mode . view mode is a UI and operations lens and must not be mixed with install mode or work mode . The current default is superadmin developer ; for public or multi user deployment, permissions must be enforced through snapshot collection, server authorization, authentication and authorization, and tests, not client side hiding alone.

Platform UI should support a subtly cute and quietly delightful tone while prioritizing clarity, scanability, accessibility, and operational trust. This tone should be applied only through maintainable, usability preserving details such as small color accents, status signals, friendly empty states, and restrained micro interactions; decorative clutter, emoji heavy UI, and visual noise should be avoided.

The platform shall provide infrastructure expert agent for infrastructure, deployment, cloud architecture, SRE, IaC, Kubernetes, networking, security, cost, observability, backup/disaster recovery, and operations readiness decisions. This agent shall not finalize production infrastructure advice from memory alone; it shall separate official provider docs, SRE/reliability evidence, IaC/Kubernetes official docs, security/compliance guidance, and local repository evidence. Provisioning, deletion, migration, secret, DNS/network, or cost impacting work shall not proceed without a human checkpoint, dry run/plan, rollback, blast radius note, and monitoring/verification plan.

The platform shall provide timekeeper agent , a corporate timekeeper style agent that keeps task time, deadlines, duration, timeboxes, critical path, slack, schedule risk, bottlenecks, next checkpoints, and hurry up trade offs visible. The agent shall not interpret "hurry" as permission to skip verification; it shall separate hard deadlines, soft targets, estimates, and user pressure, then recommend scope trimming, parallelization, ship first sequencing, deferred improvements, notifications, or human decision inbox routing.

The platform shall provide positive vision agent , which turns "somehow make it happen" requests into grounded positive vision, agency, pathways, if then implementation plans, risk truth, and fallback options. The agent shall not use optimism as unsupported success guarantees, risk hiding, dissent suppression, or quality/safety/factual verification bypass; it shall pair the desired future state with concrete first actions, multiple pathways, verification gates, and human decision inbox routing.

The platform shall provide profit analyst agent , which evaluates work, projects, products, features, pricing, outsourcing, automation, and infrastructure cost from a money and profit perspective. The agent shall make revenue/cost drivers, ROI, NPV, payback, break even, unit economics, pricing, opportunity cost, scenario/sensitivity, and source provenance explicit. Personal investment, lending, tax, legal, accounting, and regulated finance decisions shall be routed to professional review or human checkpoints, and money upside shall not bypass safety, law, privacy, trust, or quality verification.

All agents shall strongly adhere to durable principles. Principles are execution contracts and close out gates, not decoration. The platform shall provide principle guardian agent so speed, profit, optimism, convenience, or user pressure cannot silently bypass required evidence, safety, privacy, legality, quality, provenance, validation, or evaluation. Principle conflicts shall record governing source, decision reason, compliant alternative, human checkpoint, or reversible path.

When multiple agents, sources, principles, or options are all defensible and the remaining choice depends on values, preference, risk appetite, strategy, authority, accountability, or an irreversible trade off, the platform shall not let the AI finalize a fake certain conclusion. It shall use human arbitration agent to create an arbitration packet and register a decision record in ops/coordination/human decision inbox.json . The agent shall record evidence for each side, trade offs, affected principles, recommended default, reversible temporary path, blocked work , unblocked work , and resume action ; before the answer arrives, only affected work pauses and safe independent work continues.

The installable desktop platform shall define a macOS runnable structure. The macOS structure shall separate developer local run, internal test .app , and public distribution app, and manage the Tauri first .app shell, workspace monitor UI reuse, Python agent platform sidecar/local service boundary, optional CLI adapter degradation, user workspace selection, Developer ID signing, hardened runtime, notarization, stapling when applicable, update/rollback, and clean Mac smoke tests in platform desktop app/configs/macos execution profile.json .

The platform shall be able to observe repeated work, bottlenecks, omissions, validation failures, manual rework, and recurring research/prompt/tool patterns while doing varied tasks, then automatically create capability addition candidates and improvement ideas. This bounded black box process may feel like automatic improvement to the user, but it shall record observations, triggers, human process model, human work artifacts, generated ideas, idea evaluation scores, selected idea, rejected/queued idea reasons, candidates, evidence, risk, capability type, rejected lighter options, validation, rollback, documentation, evaluation, and commit/push traces. Generated ideas shall come from the modeled steps a competent person would directly perform, not only from the user's phrasing. Destructive, high risk, secret bearing, install, permission, cost, public deployment, security, or privacy impacting changes shall not auto execute without a human checkpoint.

The installable desktop platform shall treat both macOS and Windows as realistic distribution targets, and the first implementation path shall follow a Tauri v2/Rust desktop shell, workspace monitor static UI, Python agent platform layer, and optional AI coding CLI adapter architecture. The Windows structure shall be managed in platform desktop app/configs/windows execution profile.json , covering MSI/NSIS/MSIX, WebView2, code signing, SmartScreen/download trust, install/uninstall/update/rollback, and clean Windows smoke tests. Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and Antigravity shall be configurable capabilities, not required platform runtimes.

The platform shall manage language mode separately from view mode , work mode , install mode , and source code language filters in UIs and snapshots that display documents, history, requirements, and specs. The default language mode is all language view, while Korean only and English only modes shall show only documents tagged ko and en respectively. This mode is a display lens, not translation, redaction, or a security boundary; if a public deployment must exclude a language, the collector or publication review must remove it.

When a request is too broad, has too many candidate files, spans multiple projects, or creates context pressure, the platform shall run large scope decomposer agent before implementation or parallel execution. It shall record source inventory, exclusions, representative samples, slices, touch paths , dependencies, merge gates, verification plan, context budget, source provenance, and plan evidence. Agents shall not read every file or dump large source bundles by default; they shall use repository maps, code search, dependency graphs, indexes, sampling, affected checks, and global smoke checks to manage scope and verification.

Sensitive files, tokens, keys, credentials, private notes, browser cookies, and user provided private files shall be centrally routed to private/sensitive/ or an external secret manager, and AI agents shall not directly read or index private/ contents by default. Agents shall ask for redacted extracts first; direct inspection requires explicit one time permission for the exact path, operation, purpose, retention, and redaction rule. Repository maps, Workspace Monitor snapshots, source collectors, public artifacts, and installers shall not include private/ contents or raw secrets. Root folders shall be explained through project plane, operations control plane, knowledge/reuse plane, runtime adapter plane, protected local plane, and generated local plane.

Whole workspace completeness audits shall cover documentation, naming, privacy, structure, map/board freshness, memory bootstrap, current core config contracts, agent platform tests, presentation browser validation, desktop app readiness, shared tool tests, and workspace monitor tests/typecheck/build. Root generated outputs shall be classified through generated output dirs , and real unfinished signals shall be separated from plan section or template signals so false positives do not recur.

Platform operating philosophy shall not remain standalone documentation. Each core principle shall be traceable to source philosophy text, execution targets, and validation targets. When philosophy/ or a durable principle changes, philosophy traceability.json , philosophy governance docs, philosophy alignment workflow/prompt, memory bootstrap, and workspace health shall be updated together and pass check philosophy trace .

Platform UX and design improvements shall not be treated as visual decoration only. They shall apply deep researched AI UX, dashboard hierarchy, system status visibility, user control, evidence trail, and decision recovery principles to workspace monitor and platform desktop app first views, user flows, and validation artifacts. The first view shall show current status, attention items, next actions, evidence, and view/language controls before deeper document/source/requirement drill downs.

The platform shall not assume AI understands prohibition heavy instructions as stable behavior rules. Instructions such as do not , never , avoid , or no X shall be converted into positive target behavior, allowed behavior, replacement action, examples, output contract, and verification or enforcement gates before use. Security, privacy, cost, publication, and destructive changes shall be controlled structurally through allowlists, schemas, permission gates, privacy audits, evaluators, tests, rollback paths, or equivalent controls rather than prompt prohibition alone.

The platform shall use structural guardrails for material risk. When work touches security, privacy, cost, publication, deployment, deletion or mutation, external tool calls, file access, permissions, or high risk factual claims, the agent shall record the risk surface, selected guardrail, allowed actions, blocked actions, fallback or escalation action, and verification evidence before execution. Low risk reversible work may use light checks, but prompt wording alone shall not be treated as control for high impact behavior.

The installable desktop platform shall support Claude Code CLI, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, and OpenCode as first AI CLI adapter candidates while remaining independent from any one CLI. Multi CLI work shall be managed by a platform supervisor with process graph, lane state, terminal I/O bounds, stdin policy, decision inbox deferral, artifact/log retention, merge gates, and cleanup. Terminal output shall accumulate as structured records and reusable knowledge candidates with provenance, redaction, validation, and retention, not only as raw scrollback.
저장소는 개인 에이전트 구축 플랫폼과 여러 프로젝트를 장기 관리하는 monorepo로 운영해야 한다.
의미 있는 변경은 커밋하고 즉시 origin/main 에 push해야 한다.
모든 새 사용자 지시는 웹 검색으로 시작하고 공개 검색 기록을 남겨야 한다.
사용자 요청은 의미 요약으로 저장하고, 요청 결과 추적표에서 산출물/평가/커밋과 연결해야 한다.
요구사항은 사용자 작업에서 도출하고, 검토/변경/기준선화한 뒤 구현과 평가의 기준으로 사용해야 한다.
의미 있는 작업은 작업 요약, 계획 기록, 평가 보고서, 상세 히스토리를 남겨야 한다.
작업 결과가 초기 지시와 요구사항에 맞는지 평가하고, gap은 재작업해야 한다.
AI가 세팅을 잊지 않도록 세션 시작 시 메모리 부트스트랩 anchor를 확인해야 한다.
코딩 작업은 Python first, 조사 first, 오픈소스 검토 first를 기본으로 해야 한다.
최종 산출물의 사실 주장은 근거 기반으로 검증하고, 지식 베이스는 틀릴 수 있다고 가정해야 한다.
병렬 작업과 진행 중인 에이전트는 한 곳에서 상태를 볼 수 있어야 한다.
프로젝트 전용 산출물은 해당 프로젝트에 두고, 공통 자산만 폴더로 승격해야 한다.
의미 있는 구현 작업은 spec driven 방식처럼 스펙, 계획, 작업 목록, 검증, traceability 산출물을 거쳐야 한다.
커스텀 스킬 생성/수정은 명시적인 원본, trigger 예시, 검증, 전진 테스트, 개선 backlog, 평가 target을 남겨야 한다.
소스 코드 작성 전에는 best fit 아키텍처와 reference architecture를 조사하고 최소 두 개의 구조 후보와 선택 근거를 기록해야 한다.
대기업 엔지니어링, 공식 연구소, architecture center, 고신뢰 독립 출처 목록은 일반 source taxonomy와 분리된 registry로 관리해야 한다.
중요한 원천값, 설정값, 주장, 리뷰 신호, 가정, 계획 제약은 출처와 접근일을 추적하고, 모든 중요한 계획 단계는 근거와 연결해야 한다.
웹 검색은 사람이 실제로 검색하듯 세계 기술 블로그, 한국 빅테크 기술 블로그, 인도 기술 소스, 논문 검색 원천, 한국 로컬 리뷰 채널을 폭넓게 사용해야 한다.
한국 사용자 리뷰나 로컬 판단이 필요한 조사에서는 Naver Map, Kakao Map, Naver Blog/Search, 공식 페이지를 우선 확인하고 후보 페이지 품질을 평가해야 한다.
작업 성격에 따라 quick , standard , ship first , research , governance 모드를 선택하고, 모드별로 필수 산출물과 지연 개선을 다르게 관리해야 한다.
코딩 조사는 기술 스택별 공식 문서/표준, 버전 제약, high signal 이슈/토론 출처와 커뮤니티 신호 해석을 기록해야 한다.
코딩 조사는 유지보수 가능한 언어/런타임 선택, 아키텍처 이론과 실무자 의견의 분리 비교, 폴더 구조 후보와 폴더 의미를 기록해야 한다.
속도가 문제되거나 작업이 독립 lane으로 나뉠 수 있으면 병렬 실행 전 의존성, touch paths, 충돌 제어, coordination target, merge/rollback 전략을 검증해야 한다.
여러 조사 lane을 병렬 실행할 때는 모든 조사 lane을 기다리는 merge gate를 두고, contradiction/accepted evidence를 합성한 뒤 downstream 구현을 release해야 한다.
플랫폼은 Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams 알림을 설정 파일로 켜고 끌 수 있어야 하며, 실제 토큰이나 웹훅 URL은 사용자가 환경변수로 주입해야 한다.
루트 폴더 구조는 등록된 프로젝트, 예약 운영 폴더, 로컬 전용 폴더, 생성 산출물로 분류되어야 하며, 구조 변경 후 deterministic audit를 통과해야 한다.
등록된 프로젝트의 durable top level folder는 프로젝트 등록부에 설명되어야 하며, generated output pattern은 .gitignore 와 함께 검증되어야 한다.
이 저장소의 AI assistant 운영 원칙은 Codex 전용으로 고정하지 않고 Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, 또는 사용자가 선호하는 도구에서도 사용할 수 있는 tool agnostic principle과 thin runtime adapter 구조로 관리해야 한다.

마케팅, 소비자 인사이트, 시장 규모, 브랜드/GTM, 책/이론, 설문, 정량 수치 근거 조사는 marketing evidence profile.json 을 사용해 책/학술, 설문 방법론, 공개 통계, 시장 리포트, 플랫폼 행동 데이터의 evidence lane을 분리하고, 모든 숫자 근거의 값/단위/base/지역/기간/모집단/방법론/표본/스폰서/비교 가능성을 기록해야 한다.

프로젝트 스펙이 애매하거나 현재 소스/테스트/산출물과 다를 경우, 구현 전에 비교 근거를 기록하고 update spec , update source , ask user , defer 중 하나로 분류해야 한다. ask user 이슈는 안정적인 질문 ID, 선택지, 답변 형식, 결정 영향을 포함한 clarification needed 알림으로 사용자에게 질문하고, 답변이 기록되기 전까지 해당 스펙이나 소스를 변경하지 않아야 한다.

docs/ 는 instructions , policies , operating models , governance 카테고리로 관리해야 하며, 새 문서가 루트에 흩어지거나 필수 문서가 누락되지 않도록 docs/registry.json 과 docs audit 로 root 허용 파일, category placement, 필수 문서, 한영 companion을 검증해야 한다.

전체 저장소 navigation과 health check는 ops/projects/root structure policy.json , ops/projects/registry.json , docs/registry.json 같은 source of truth를 사용해야 하며, root folder class/source와 핵심 감사/테스트를 한 곳에서 확인할 수 있어야 한다.
저장소 운영 CLI는 유지보수를 위해 사람용 출력과 자동화용 JSON 출력을 분리하고, 필요한 검사 범위만 실행할 수 있는 category filter를 제공해야 한다.
저장소 운영 도구의 소스가 커지면 단일 스크립트에 CLI, 도메인 모델, 체크 정의, 실행, 직렬화를 섞지 말고 책임별 모듈로 분리해야 하며 기존 명령 호환성은 보존해야 한다.
프로젝트, 도구, 스킬, 문서, 스펙, 히스토리, 설정, 소스 코드의 durable name은 네임스페이스별 규칙으로 관리하고, 변경 후 deterministic naming audit를 통과해야 한다.
플랫폼 컨셉과 운영 철학은 주기적으로 재검토하고, 인간 최종 권한, scoped autonomy, rollback 가능성, 보안/프라이버시, 운영 비용과 agentic debt가 철학과 메모리 부트스트랩에 반영되어야 한다.
플랫폼은 첫 진입점과 운영 모델 문서에서 목적, 해결하는 문제, 핵심 루프, 축적되는 자산, 프로젝트 경계, 근거 기반 평가 가치를 포함한 상세한 정체성 설명을 제공해야 한다.
새 코딩 프로젝트는 기술별 blueprint로 dry run 계획을 먼저 확인하고, 적용 시 root project 등록, 프로젝트별 README/docs/specs/configs/tests/tools/artifacts, 기술별 공식 문서 체크리스트, coding research 연결점을 자동 준비할 수 있어야 한다.
의미 있는 작업은 phase별 소요시간을 history/work timings/ 에 기록하고, coordination board, Workspace Monitor, 평가 입력에서 slowest phase와 병목 후보를 확인할 수 있어야 한다.
특정 상황에서 깊은 조사가 필요하면 deep research agent 가 다중 검색 채널, 반복 조사 단계, 출처 품질 평가, evidence item, contradiction mapping, citation audit, report outline, report target을 기록하고 긴 보고서 작성 준비 상태를 검증해야 한다.
웹 검색 품질이 중요한 작업은 사람이 실제로 검색하듯 query ladder, 검색 연산자, source lane, regional/community/contrary search, snowballing, selective summary capture를 사용하고, 좋은 출처는 재사용 가능할 때만 요약해야 한다.
사용자가 AI를 더 잘 쓰고 싶어 하거나 작업 중 AI 사용 간극이 보이면, 플랫폼은 이를 개인 탓이 아니라 작업 맥락, task fit, 반복, 검증, 도구화, 자산화 gap으로 진단하고 가장 작은 bridge intervention을 적용해야 한다.
사용자 지시가 모호하거나 편향적이거나 결론을 유도하거나 검증 가능한 출력 계약이 없거나 LLM을 결정론적 진실 기계로 가정하면, 실행 전에 목표, 맥락, 제약, 출력 형식, 성공 기준, 반대 근거, 검증 경로를 포함한 중립적 task brief로 재작성해야 한다.

모델 성능과 유형에 따라 프롬프팅 전략을 달리해야 한다. 약한/비추론/불확실 모델은 비용과 지연이 허용되고 작업 편차가 크면 두 번의 독립 시도 또는 초안 비평 수정 loop를 실행해 비교/병합하고, 추론/강한 모델은 불필요한 중복 호출보다 명확한 목표/맥락/제약/검증을 우선해야 한다. 반복 호출 결과는 사실 증명이 아니므로 출처, 테스트, 도구, evaluator 또는 인간 판단으로 검증해야 한다.

플랫폼의 최종 목적은 사람의 반복적인 작업을 계속 줄이고, 더 효율적인 방법을 만들며, 작업 시간을 줄이는 것이다. 이를 위해 에이전트는 인간이 실제로 수행하는 조사/판단/실행/검증 프로세스를 관찰해 재현 가능한 단계로 모델링하고, 자동화 가치가 있는 반복은 프롬프트, 워크플로, 템플릿, 도구, 스킬, 에이전트 또는 프로젝트 기능으로 승격해야 한다. 자동화는 인간 판단이 필요한 지점과 검증/rollback 경계를 보존해야 한다.

모호한 사용자 지시는 나쁜 결과의 주요 원인이므로 에이전트는 필요할 때 역질문으로 목적, 맥락, 제약, 출력 계약, 성공 기준을 구체화해야 한다. 단, 질문이 무한히 이어지지 않도록 clarification budget 을 적용해 보통 1회, 많아도 2회 이내로 묶고, 질문은 최대 3개까지 우선순위화해야 한다. 답변이 없거나 계속 모호하면 합리적 가정으로 진행, 선택지 기반 기본값 적용, 선작업 후 확인, 또는 명시적 보류 중 하나로 수렴해야 한다.

사용자 답변 대기나 clarification needed 가 발생해도 전체 작업을 멈추지 않아야 한다. 에이전트는 답변 없이는 결정할 수 없는 항목만 blocked decision 으로 격리하고, 영향받지 않는 조사, 출처 수집, 대안 비교, 초안 작성, 테스트, 검증, 문서화, 리스크 정리는 계속 진행해야 한다. 진행 중 사용한 가정, 기본값, 보류 항목, 답변 수신 후 병합/수정 방법은 unblocked work , assumptions , resume action 으로 기록해야 한다.

여러 blocked decision , clarification needed , 승인, 선호 결정은 흩어진 채팅이 아니라 중앙 human decision inbox에 모아야 한다. 각 항목은 안정적인 ID, 질문/선택지, 답변 형식, 의존 작업, 현재 진행 가능한 작업, 알림 이벤트, 답변 수신 후 interrupt policy , checkpoint required , resume action 을 포함해야 한다. 사람이 돌아와 답변하면 에이전트는 현재 작업을 안전하게 checkpoint하고, 우선순위와 위험도에 따라 해당 작업을 인터럽트해 재개하거나 다음 안전 지점에 예약한 뒤 inbox 상태를 갱신해야 한다.

플랫폼 설치는 work mode 와 별개의 install mode 로 관리해야 한다. user 설치는 플랫폼 사용, 산출물 보기, monitor 실행/배포처럼 사용자를 위한 최소 regular/runtime 경로를 제공하고, developer 설치는 플랫폼 개선, 소스 수정, 검증 harness 변경, 공통 규칙 변경을 위한 editable install, devDependencies, 테스트, governance check를 제공해야 한다. 설치 명령이 실제로 실행되어 dependency나 환경 상태가 바뀌면 기존 설치 감사 기록 규칙을 따라야 한다.

플랫폼을 사용자가 설치하는 desktop/end user software로 제품화할 때는 platform desktop app/ 별도 루트 프로젝트에서 관리해야 한다. end user installer packaging은 레포지토리 setup install mode 와 구분하고, Tauri/Electron/native packaging 후보 비교, OS별 installer format, signing/notarization, update, uninstall/rollback, secret/privacy, dependency/license review, installer smoke test release gate를 기록해야 한다.

플랫폼 컴포넌트의 언어/런타임은 Python, TypeScript/Next.js, Rust/Tauri, Go, Electron을 일괄 선호하지 말고 컴포넌트 경계와 측정 가능한 병목에 따라 선택해야 한다. 기본값은 Python for agent logic, TypeScript/Next.js for UI, Rust/Tauri for desktop shell/native command boundary, Go for local daemon/CLI, Electron as fallback이며, Rust/Go 전환 전에는 bottleneck metric, prototype measurement, release gate, rollback plan을 기록해야 한다.

런타임/언어 선택은 조사에서 끝나지 않고 설계로 이어져야 한다. Rust, Go, Tauri, Wails, Electron, Python, TypeScript/Next.js 같은 선택은 공식 문서, 아키텍처/ADR 참고, 오픈소스 구현, 이슈/토론 신호, 반대 사례를 조사하고, 최소 두 후보 설계, ADR style 결정 기록, prototype measurement plan, 설치 감사/rollback 계획을 남긴 뒤 구현 또는 의존성 설치로 넘어가야 한다.

플랫폼은 설치형으로 발전하더라도 특정 CLI, AI assistant CLI, package manager, deployment CLI, vendor shell에 종속되면 안 된다. 설치형 플랫폼은 workspace, history, docs, evaluation, settings, UI, orchestration layer를 제공하고, 외부 CLI는 availability/version/permission/output/fallback contract를 가진 교체 가능한 adapter로 붙여야 한다. CLI가 없으면 전체 플랫폼 실패가 아니라 capability missing 으로 degrade해야 하며, CLI를 required/bundled/global install 대상으로 승격하기 전에는 설치 감사, 보안 경계, rollback, 검증 명령을 기록해야 한다.

플랫폼은 AI의 핵심 강점 중 하나를 비정형 또는 반정형 데이터를 정형 기록으로 바꾸는 능력으로 취급해야 한다. 긴 대화, 조사 자료, 문서, 리뷰, 로그, 메모, 스크린샷을 요구사항, 스펙, 태스크, evidence item, 표, JSON, 평가 입력으로 바꿀 때는 target schema, source provenance, null/ambiguity handling, validation note를 함께 남겨야 하며, 정형화 결과를 근거나 자동화 입력으로 쓰기 전에는 schema validation과 sample/source audit를 거쳐야 한다.

작업 모드는 단순 프롬프트 선호가 아니라 강제 가능한 실행 계약이어야 한다. quick 이 아닌 standard , ship first , research , governance 작업은 모드 선택 이유, override, enforcement check를 기록한 mode selection record targets 를 평가 입력에 포함해야 하며, 모드 정책이나 evaluator target이 바뀌면 check work modes 가 registry와 evaluator drift를 검사해야 한다.

에이전트는 필수 항목을 빠뜨릴 수 있다고 가정해야 한다. quick 이 아닌 작업은 사용자 지시, 요구사항, 계획 항목, 필수 산출물, acceptance check를 covered , deferred , not applicable , missing 으로 분류한 누락 방지 coverage 기록을 남기고, omission check targets 를 평가 입력에 포함해야 한다. 필수 missing 항목, 근거 없는 covered , 이유 없는 deferred / not applicable 은 close out 전 재작업 대상이다.

플랫폼은 메모리 누수와 런타임 리소스 누수를 신뢰성 위험으로 다뤄야 한다. 장시간 실행 에이전트, 서버, 브라우저 자동화, subprocess, worker, queue, cache, stream, 대용량 처리, 파일 핸들, 네트워크 연결, timer, subscription을 건드리는 작업은 resource risk occurred=true 로 표시하고, 리소스 위험, 생명주기 cleanup path, 측정 또는 수용 근거를 기록한 resource check targets 를 평가 입력에 포함해야 한다. 필수 unresolved 위험, 근거 없는 mitigation, cleanup path 누락, 측정 근거 누락은 close out 전 재작업 대상이다.

플랫폼은 하나의 동작이 여러 CLI 프로세스를 실행하거나 stdout/stderr/stdin pipe, fan out/fan in, merge gate를 사용할 때 이를 shell string이 아니라 검증 가능한 process graph로 모델링해야 한다. 각 process node는 adapter, command, args, cwd, env allowlist, timeout, output bound를 가져야 하며, pipe edge, safety control, resource control, source provenance, plan evidence, verification, rollback을 기록해야 한다. 해당 작업은 cli pipeline occurred=true 와 cli pipeline targets 를 평가 입력에 포함해야 하며, 필수 process/pipe/safety/resource/provenance/verification 누락은 close out 전 재작업 대상이다.

CLI pipeline이 파일, 임시 파일, 디렉터리, cache, log, report, 기타 artifact로 handoff하면 각 artifact는 artifact id , kind, workspace relative path, producer/consumer, size bound, format, cleanup/retention policy, provenance, validation을 명시해야 한다. mode=file 또는 mode=artifact pipe는 artifact id 를 참조해야 하며, absolute path, drive prefix, backslash, ~ , .. 가 있는 경로는 재작업 대상이다.

플랫폼은 다양한 reusable agent를 쉽게 만들고 여러 agent를 안전하게 오케스트레이션할 수 있어야 한다. 새 agent 또는 multi agent 작업은 agent spec contract, blueprint, creation pipeline, orchestration pattern, state/handoff/tool/human/observability/resource/evaluation controls, lifecycle gate, validation command를 agent orchestration registry.json 으로 관리하고 check agent orchestration 으로 검증해야 한다. 중앙 manager가 subagent를 도구처럼 호출하는 구조는 plan agent orchestration 으로 manager, subagent tool roster, tool access, state/handoff/control, validation plan을 실행 전 JSON으로 산출해야 한다.

플랫폼은 사용자 보기, 개발자 보기, 슈퍼어드민 개발 보기를 view mode 로 분리해야 한다. view mode 는 UI/운영 화면 렌즈이고, install mode 와 work mode 와 섞지 않는다. 현재 기본값은 superadmin developer 이며, public 또는 multi user 배포에서는 client side hiding이 아니라 snapshot collector, server authorization, 인증/인가, 테스트에서 권한을 강제해야 한다.

플랫폼 UI는 명확성, 훑어보기, 접근성, 운영 신뢰를 우선하면서도 은근히 귀엽고 조용히 기분 좋은 톤을 사용할 수 있어야 한다. 이 톤은 작은 색상 accent, 상태 신호, 친근한 empty state, 절제된 micro interaction처럼 사용성과 유지보수성을 해치지 않는 방식으로만 적용하고, 장식 과잉, emoji 남용, 시각적 소음은 피해야 한다.

플랫폼은 인프라, 배포, 클라우드 아키텍처, SRE, IaC, Kubernetes, 네트워크, 보안, 비용, 관측성, 백업/재해복구, 운영 준비성 판단을 맡는 infrastructure expert agent 를 제공해야 한다. 이 에이전트는 프로덕션 인프라 조언을 기억만으로 확정하지 않고 공식 provider 문서, SRE/reliability 근거, IaC/Kubernetes 공식 문서, security/compliance 문서, local repository evidence를 분리해 기록해야 하며, provisioning/deletion/migration/secret/DNS/network/cost impacting 작업은 human checkpoint, dry run/plan, rollback, blast radius, monitoring/verification 계획 없이는 진행하지 않아야 한다.

플랫폼은 기업의 Timekeeper처럼 작업 시간, 마감, 기간, timebox, critical path, slack, schedule risk, 병목, 다음 checkpoint, 빨리 하기 위한 trade off를 계속 드러내는 timekeeper agent 를 제공해야 한다. 이 에이전트는 “빨리 해야 한다”는 압박을 검증 생략으로 해석하지 않고, hard deadline/soft target/추정/사용자 압박을 구분하며, scope 축소, 병렬화, ship first, 후속 개선 분리, 알림 또는 human decision inbox 연결을 제안해야 한다.

플랫폼은 어려운 작업에서 “어떻게든 해내자”는 요청을 근거 있는 긍정적 비전, agency, pathways, if then 실행계획, risk truth, fallback으로 바꾸는 positive vision agent 를 제공해야 한다. 이 에이전트는 낙관을 근거 없는 성공 보장, 위험 은폐, 반대 의견 억압, 품질/안전/사실 검증 생략으로 쓰지 않아야 하며, 원하는 미래 상태와 구체적인 첫 행동, 복수 경로, 검증 게이트, human decision inbox 연결을 함께 제시해야 한다.

플랫폼은 작업, 프로젝트, 제품, 기능, 가격, 외주, 자동화, 인프라 비용을 돈과 이득 관점에서 판단하는 profit analyst agent 를 제공해야 한다. 이 에이전트는 수익/비용 드라이버, ROI, NPV, payback, break even, unit economics, pricing, opportunity cost, scenario/sensitivity, source provenance를 명시해야 하며, 개인 투자/대출/세무/법률/회계/규제 금융 판단은 전문가 검토 또는 human checkpoint 대상으로 분리하고, 돈이 된다는 이유로 안전/법/개인정보/신뢰/품질 검증을 우회하지 않아야 한다.

모든 에이전트는 영속 원칙을 강하게 고수해야 한다. 원칙은 장식 문구가 아니라 실행 계약과 close out gate이며, 플랫폼은 principle guardian agent 를 통해 속도, 돈, 낙관, 편의, 사용자 압박이 필요한 근거, 안전, 개인정보, 법, 품질, provenance, 검증, 평가를 무단 우회하지 못하게 해야 한다. 원칙 충돌은 governing source, 선택 이유, compliant alternative, human checkpoint 또는 reversible path와 함께 기록해야 한다.

여러 에이전트, 근거, 원칙, 옵션이 모두 방어 가능하고 남은 선택이 가치판단, 선호, 위험감수성, 전략, 권한, 책임소재, 되돌리기 어려운 trade off에 달려 있으면 플랫폼은 AI가 임의로 결론을 확정하지 않고 human arbitration agent 로 arbitration packet을 만들고 ops/coordination/human decision inbox.json 에 decision record를 등록해야 한다. 에이전트는 각 입장의 근거, 장단점, 충돌 원칙, 추천 기본값, 되돌릴 수 있는 임시 경로, blocked work , unblocked work , resume action 을 기록하고, 답변 전에는 영향받는 결정만 멈추며 안전한 비의존 작업은 계속해야 한다.

설치형 데스크톱 플랫폼은 macOS에서 실행 가능한 구조를 명시해야 한다. macOS 구조는 개발자 로컬 실행, 내부 테스트 .app , 외부 배포 앱을 구분하고, Tauri first .app shell, workspace monitor UI 재사용, Python agent platform sidecar/local service 경계, optional CLI adapter degrade, 사용자 workspace 선택, Developer ID signing, hardened runtime, notarization, 가능한 경우 stapling, update/rollback, clean Mac smoke test를 platform desktop app/configs/macos execution profile.json 에서 관리해야 한다.

플랫폼은 다양한 작업을 수행하는 중 반복, 병목, 누락, 검증 실패, 수동 재작업, 자주 쓰는 조사/프롬프트/도구 패턴을 관찰해 기능 추가 후보와 개선 아이디어를 자동으로 만들 수 있어야 한다. 이 bounded black box 처리는 사용자에게는 자동 개선처럼 보이더라도 내부적으로 observation, trigger, human process model, human work artifacts, generated ideas, idea evaluation scores, selected idea, rejected/queued idea reasons, candidate, evidence, risk, capability type, rejected lighter options, validation, rollback, documentation, evaluation, commit/push trace를 남겨야 하며, generated ideas는 사용자 문구만이 아니라 유능한 사람이 직접 수행하는 작업 단계에서 나와야 한다. destructive/high risk/secret/install/권한/비용/public 배포/보안·개인정보 변경은 human checkpoint 없이 자동 실행하지 않아야 한다.

설치형 데스크톱 플랫폼은 macOS와 Windows를 모두 현실적인 배포 대상으로 다뤄야 하며, 첫 구현 경로는 Tauri v2/Rust desktop shell, workspace monitor 정적 UI, Python agent platform 계층, optional AI coding CLI adapter 구조를 따라야 한다. Windows 구조는 platform desktop app/configs/windows execution profile.json 에서 MSI/NSIS/MSIX, WebView2, code signing, SmartScreen/download trust, install/uninstall/update/rollback, clean Windows smoke test를 관리해야 하며, Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity는 플랫폼 필수 런타임이 아니라 설정 가능한 capability로 취급해야 한다.

플랫폼은 문서/히스토리/요구사항/스펙을 보여주는 UI와 snapshot에서 language mode 를 view mode , work mode , install mode , 소스코드 언어 필터와 분리해 관리해야 한다. 기본 언어 모드는 전체 보기이며, 한국어만 보기와 영어만 보기는 각각 ko , en 으로 태그된 문서만 보여야 한다. 이 모드는 번역, redaction, 보안 경계가 아니라 표시 렌즈이며, public 배포에서 언어별 제외가 필요하면 collector 또는 publication review에서 제거해야 한다.

요청 범위가 너무 크거나, 후보 파일이 너무 많거나, 여러 프로젝트를 넘나들거나, 컨텍스트 압박이 있으면 플랫폼은 구현이나 병렬 실행 전에 large scope decomposer agent 로 source inventory, 제외 기준, 대표 샘플, slice, touch paths , 의존성, merge gate, 검증 계획, context budget, source provenance, plan evidence를 기록해야 한다. 기본적으로 모든 파일을 읽거나 대량 소스 묶음을 프롬프트에 넣지 말고, repository map, code search, dependency graph, index, sampling, affected checks, global smoke checks로 범위와 검증을 관리해야 한다.

민감 파일, token, key, credential, private note, browser cookie, user provided private file은 private/sensitive/ 또는 외부 secret manager로 중앙 라우팅해야 하며, AI 에이전트는 private/ 내부를 기본적으로 직접 읽거나 색인하지 않아야 한다. 필요한 정보는 redacted extract를 우선 요청하고, 직접 열람은 특정 경로/작업/목적/보존 범위/redaction 규칙에 대한 명시적 1회 허가가 있을 때만 가능하다. repository map, workspace monitor snapshot, source collector, public artifact, installer는 private/ 와 raw secret을 포함하지 않아야 하며, 최상위 폴더는 project plane, operations control plane, knowledge/reuse plane, runtime adapter plane, protected local plane, generated local plane으로 설명되어야 한다.

전체 워크스페이스 완성도 감사는 문서, 네이밍, privacy, 구조, 지도/보드 freshness, memory bootstrap, 최신 core config contract, agent platform tests, presentation browser validation, desktop app readiness, shared tool tests, workspace monitor tests/typecheck/build를 포함해야 한다. generated output이 루트에 생기면 policy의 generated output dirs 에 맞춰 분류되어야 하며, 실제 미완 신호와 계획 섹션/템플릿 신호를 분리해 false positive가 반복되지 않게 해야 한다.

플랫폼 운영 철학은 독립 문서에 머무르면 안 되며, 각 핵심 원칙은 철학 원문 위치, 실행 대상, 검증 대상에 추적 가능하게 연결되어야 한다. philosophy/ 나 durable principle이 바뀌면 philosophy traceability.json , 철학 거버넌스 문서, 철학 alignment workflow/prompt, memory bootstrap, workspace health가 함께 갱신되어야 하고 check philosophy trace 를 통과해야 한다.

플랫폼 UX와 디자인 개선은 감각적 장식만으로 처리하면 안 되며, 딥리서치로 확인한 AI UX, dashboard hierarchy, system status visibility, user control, evidence trail, decision recovery 원칙을 workspace monitor 와 platform desktop app 의 첫 화면/사용자 흐름/검증 산출물에 반영해야 한다. 첫 화면은 현재 상태, 주의 필요 항목, 다음 행동, 근거, 보기/언어 모드를 먼저 보여주고, 세부 문서/소스/요구사항은 탐색 가능한 drill down으로 이어져야 한다.

플랫폼은 AI가 금지형 지시를 안정적인 행동 규칙으로 이해한다고 가정하지 않아야 한다. 하지 마라 , 절대 하지 마라 , 피해라 , no X 같은 금지형 지시는 긍정형 행동 목표, 허용 행동, 대체 행동, 예시, 출력 계약, 검증 또는 강제 게이트로 변환한 뒤 사용해야 하며, 보안/개인정보/비용/배포/파괴적 변경은 프롬프트 금지가 아니라 allowlist, schema, permission gate, privacy audit, evaluator, test, rollback 같은 구조적 통제로 다뤄야 한다.

플랫폼은 실질적 위험이 있는 작업에 구조적 가드레일을 둬야 한다. 보안, 개인정보, 비용, 공개, 배포, 삭제/수정, 외부 도구 호출, 파일 접근, 권한, 고위험 사실 주장이 포함되면 실행 전에 위험 표면, 선택한 가드레일, 허용 행동, 차단 행동, 실패 시 대체 행동 또는 escalation, 검증 증거를 기록해야 한다. 낮은 위험의 되돌릴 수 있는 작업은 가벼운 체크를 사용할 수 있지만, prompt 문구만으로 고위험 행동을 통제한다고 간주하면 안 된다.

설치형 데스크톱 플랫폼은 Claude Code CLI, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, OpenCode를 첫 AI CLI adapter 후보로 지원하되 어떤 CLI에도 종속되지 않아야 한다. 여러 CLI를 동시에 쓰는 작업은 process graph, lane state, terminal I/O bound, stdin policy, decision inbox deferral, artifact/log retention, merge gate, cleanup을 가진 platform supervisor가 관리해야 하며, 터미널 output은 raw scrollback이 아니라 provenance, redaction, validation, retention을 갖춘 structured records와 reusable knowledge candidate로 축적되어야 한다.
The project shall be a Vercel deployable Next.js project.
The app shall let the user browse repository history, work summaries, request traces, projects, agent/task status, requirements, specs, and evaluations from one UI.
Markdown documents shall be viewable as readable HTML previews.
The app shall work locally while the repository is private and be deployable to Vercel after the repository is made public.
The structure shall be extensible, separating document parsing, UI components, data models, and deployment settings.
The project shall support pre publication review for sensitive data in generated snapshots.

The app shall collect work summaries, user requests, request traces, web searches, plans, evaluations, and daily history under history/ into a date indexed web UI that can be filtered by date and type.
The web UI should show root folder structure, docs categories, project top level homes, and history source roots so folder boundaries and data provenance are understandable.
The UI shall combine agent definitions from agent platform/configs/agents/ with coordination runtime state so users can visually see which agents exist.
The UI shall visualize history/ document density by date and distribution by history type.

The UI shall read agent platform/configs/access/view mode registry.json and allow selecting user , developer , and superadmin developer view modes, with superadmin development view as the current default.
The UI shall let developer and superadmin development views browse source code from key projects and tools as read only content.
The UI shall show which work lane each agent is moving through and which task/project each agent is connected to through a collaboration board and flow map.
The web UI should allow a subtly cute, quietly delightful visual tone while preserving operational density and trust.

The web UI shall read agent platform/configs/access/language mode registry.json and allow selecting all language, Korean only, and English only document views, applying the same language lens to documents, history, and summary counts.

The web UI shall not embed the large workspace snapshot directly in the client JavaScript bundle, and shall provide a regression check that keeps initial JavaScript chunks within the performance budget.

The static export shall render the main dashboard not only from an HTTP root, but also from desktop shell, file/subpath like contexts, and repository subpath static serving by loading next assets and workspace snapshot.json through relative paths.

The web UI shall merge separated history records, evaluations, web searches, work timings, request traces, collaboration tasks, blockers, and next actions into a single unifiedOps event stream that can be browsed from one screen.

The web UI shall explicitly show view/work/install/language/desktop session/task pipe/CLI adapter/monitor section modes and functions in one place, including where each item can be selected or opened.
The web UI should provide a compact operating surface near the top of Overview that shows current section state, attention level, next action, evidence counts, and a runtime shortcut.

The web UI shall read the latest user intent feature map from history and let developer/superadmin views browse intent counts, feature themes, implemented capabilities, next candidates, the Now/Next/Later roadmap, and source freshness.
The repository snapshot collector should keep feature specific data extraction logic behind clear module boundaries so continuous refactoring preserves behavior and testable ownership boundaries.

The web UI shall show the platform's operating memory, platform core, desktop product, monitor UI, domain projects, and runtime/local data planes at a glance, including ownership boundaries, primary paths, prohibited boundaries, and structural pressure points.

The web UI shall make core function locations visible in the first screen and group monitor section tabs by functional area so users can understand their current location and next navigation path immediately.

The web UI should behave more like a real app by letting users run sections, view modes, language modes, document filters, and key actions through a global command palette plus pinned/recent quick controls.

The desktop product UI shall render runtime, task pipe, service readiness, and source editor operations as full width workbench surfaces instead of cramped web cards, and shall not include the large workspace snapshot as a JavaScript fallback chunk.

The desktop source editor shall act as a platform specific editing workbench rather than a generic web editor, providing requirement/spec/validation/Tauri command/agent config/decision item templates, path based editing profiles, and patch context copying.

Desktop Source Review shall behave as a real code editing workbench by providing runtime workspace file index refresh, an open editor tab strip, Monaco command toolbar, edit/diff mode, and an editor settings popup.

Desktop Source Review shall not run an unnecessary runtime source catalog scan before the user enters the Source surface, and file list rendering shall avoid duplicate lists and fully expanded trees by default.
Repeated action buttons, segments, toolbars, and Source/Explorer controls shall use consistent click target sizes, with larger targets on touch/mobile environments.
The desktop product UI shall avoid fixed height/compressed layouts that only work fullscreen, show the primary task first, and expose secondary information through collapsed or vertical flows.
Visible features, panels, buttons, and workflow steps shall each perform one clearly named job, without mixing status, settings, navigation, execution, and evidence views inside one control or panel.

The desktop product UI shall avoid placing several functional panels into one shallow tab; when a tab starts holding multiple functions, the default tab shall become a selection menu and each function shall open as a deeper single purpose screen.

Primary desktop product sections shall reflow without root horizontal overflow at 900px, 720px, 540px, and 390px window widths, while primary navigation and repeated controls keep at least 44px visible targets.

Desktop product text shall follow the Pretendard Variable / Pretendard first mixed Korean/English sans fallback stack and role based typography scale; small supporting text shall stay explicitly small without browser default shrinking or arbitrary component font sizes.
Text on dark backgrounds, dark theme, dark rail, primary actions, active tabs, and code/source/terminal surfaces shall use an explicit white foreground token instead of translucent gray text.

Primary desktop product sections shall not overwhelm the user by opening diagnostics, records, inventory, builders, execution helpers, and evidence panels at once; the initial screen shall show one primary work surface and limited summaries, with the rest behind named detail disclosures.

Agent Core chat UI shall use a familiar ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini style structure with a central conversation log and bottom composer as the primary work surface, compact provider/model controls, and context/contract information separated into a drawer or summary area that does not push the chat input away. In the Agents screen, the common status strip, document filter, metrics, and contract cards must not push away the default chat surface, and the composer must be visible in the first viewport at 390px mobile width.

Primary tab switching shall not slow down by mounting closed secondary feature groups; heavy panels inside Agents/Desktop Runtime section level disclosures shall stay out of the React tree until the user opens them.

The Terminal/CLI execution UI shall use a familiar open source developer tool terminal structure instead of a generic card panel: terminal chrome, tab strip, dark emulator surface, monospace output, prompt input, and a status/cwd bar. Global terminal buttons shall route to a mounted terminal surface before opening the drawer.

Button clicks shall not block the first response paint with heavy workbench mount, native refresh, source filtering, evidence assembly, or other secondary work. Representative primary section button samples shall keep p95 click to paint at or below 60ms with no long tasks under CPU throttle 6 static export audit.

Tab switching shall never block the first active tab, title, and transition feedback paint with heavy body mounts, regardless of destination section. Section bodies shall mount through staged first paint deferral, and large data scans such as Source search shall only run after the destination section body is ready.

Every button and button like control shall show capture phase instant pressed feedback before React click handlers, workbench mounts, native calls, clipboard work, modal opens, or section movement begin. Representative 67 button press samples and real nav click samples shall keep feedback p95 at or below 60ms under a CPU throttle 6 static export audit.

Tool Studio Build Tool shall provide a dedicated Python tool source management sub workbench that shows the selected template's package name, module name, src/ edit targets, pyproject.toml , console entry point, smoke test path, init/run/package commands, checklist, and copy source plan action in one place.

The Overview first screen shall be a Focus Command Surface, not a flat list of equal cards: it shall show one recommended job, next step preview, and primary action first, while moving other goals and operating status into a separate dock/strip.

The desktop product UI shall use consistent color, typography, shadow, and button state tokens across the app shell, titlebar, rail, and Overview primary work surface, and shall build hierarchy around real work goals and next actions instead of exposing design principle copy in the interface.

Overview work dock goal buttons shall expose industrial design control affordance by separating index, feature icon, work description, status badge, and forward action cue so target location and execution result are immediately legible, while mobile keeps only the essential controls without layout breakage.

The Agents detail Collaboration work surface shall visualize agent collaboration as 3D characters, task lanes, and connection lines, using @react three/fiber and @react three/drei through client side lazy mounting so the default chat surface, tab switching, and closed disclosure performance are not disturbed. It shall render as a nonblank canvas without horizontal overflow at 390px mobile width.

The Agents detail disclosure shall not stack Blueprints, Builder, Learning, Collaboration, Flow, Inventory, and Runtime on one screen. It shall provide a detail workspace switcher that renders exactly one active workspace at a time. The default detail view shall start on Collaboration, and switching to another detail view shall remove the 3D canvas and prior feature DOM.

Agents detail selection shall update the selected button and pressed feedback immediately on click, while 3D canvas, form, and table workspace replacement shall commit after the first paint so button response is not tied to heavy panel mounting. Rapid detail clicks shall render only the latest selected workspace, and scheduled mounts shall be canceled when the disclosure closes or the user leaves Agents.

The default activity rail shall not require users to remember icon meanings; it shall show compact text labels with icons so primary destinations are chosen by recognition. In the default desktop width, expanded width, 720px and down top rail, and 420px and down horizontal scrolling rail, labels shall remain readable and button targets shall stay at least 44px.

Tool Studio shall not expose Build, Environment, Deploy, and Registry as one flat set of same depth tabs. It shall first let users choose a parent flow such as Create or Ship, then show only the detail modes for that flow. Direct entry from shortcuts or external task flows into a detail mode shall also synchronize the parent flow selection.

The default Tool Studio dropdown button shall clearly show the selected detail function, parent flow, menu affordance, and open state in one control while preserving aria haspopup="menu" , Radix open state, at least a 44px target, text ellipsis, and overflow free width below 860px.

Default desktop product buttons shall use a library backed shared Button primitive instead of ad hoc CSS combinations, unifying variants, sizes, icon only controls, asChild , loading/disabled states, and representative primary actions in the titlebar, task handoff, and Tool Studio surfaces.

Repeated desktop product action groups shall not recreate ad hoc flex/div structures on each screen. They shall use a shared ActionGroup primitive for alignment, spacing, wrapping, role, and density, and representative titlebar, task handoff, command palette, and Tool Studio action groups shall use that structure.

Tool Studio depth and detail functions shall not be expanded all at once. They shall use IntelliJ style action access: users can reach the same functions through the primary dropdown, an Alt+Enter quick action menu, right click context menus on parent flows/detail modes, Alt+1/2 , Alt+←/→ , and existing mode shortcuts. Left click shall directly select; right click shall open context actions for the current location.

Prose text, button/control labels, and long tokens such as paths, commands, and code shall follow a shared text wrapping contract. Korean and mixed Korean/English prose shall avoid awkward character by character breaks through keep all/natural wrapping, long tokens shall use anywhere style overflow wrapping so they do not push the layout, and button labels shall not exceed parent width.

The desktop product UI shall split scrolling by work scope, including page, activity rail, settings, terminal, source explorer, and Tool Studio list/detail/environment regions. Each scroll scope shall use overscroll behavior , stable gutter, restrained scrollbar color tokens, and paint containment where useful, while offscreen 3D/animated work shall pause so it does not degrade interaction speed.

Tool Studio source shall not keep public types, static catalog data, UI rendering, and 3D effects mixed inside one oversized component. At minimum, public types and static Tool Studio catalog data shall live in separate modules while the existing ToolStudioPanel export and mode request contract remain compatible.

Agent collaboration characters shall not read as plain cylinders and spheres. They shall use a consistent robot like silhouette that communicates role and status. The Agents collaboration scene and Tool Studio character map shall share details such as visor, chest/status detail, and role halo while keeping motion restrained and preserving existing reduce motion/offscreen pause contracts.

Agent collaboration characters shall not feel overly realistic or like hard equipment; they shall read as cute abstract animal like mascots. Soft details such as ears, cheeks, a small muzzle, and a tail may be used, but fur, anatomy, and exaggerated facial acting shall be avoided while preserving status/role legibility and performance contracts.
Vercel에 배포 가능한 Next.js 프로젝트여야 한다.
저장소의 히스토리, 작업 요약, 요청 추적, 프로젝트, 에이전트/작업 상태, 요구사항, 스펙, 평가 문서를 한 화면에서 탐색할 수 있어야 한다.
Markdown 문서를 읽기 편한 HTML preview로 보여줄 수 있어야 한다.
현재 private repository에서도 로컬로 쓸 수 있고, 나중에 public 전환 후 Vercel에 올릴 수 있어야 한다.
확장 가능한 구조여야 하며 문서 파싱, UI 컴포넌트, 데이터 모델, 배포 설정이 분리되어야 한다.
public 배포 전 민감 정보가 snapshot에 들어가는지 검토할 수 있어야 한다.
history/ 의 작업 요약, 요청 요약, 요청 추적, 웹 검색, 계획, 평가, 일일 기록을 날짜별로 모아 웹 UI에서 날짜와 유형으로 탐색할 수 있어야 한다.
웹 UI는 루트 폴더 구조, docs 카테고리, 프로젝트별 top level home, 히스토리 수집 위치를 보여줘 폴더 경계와 데이터 출처를 이해할 수 있어야 한다.
웹 UI는 agent platform/configs/agents/ 의 에이전트 정의와 coordination runtime 상태를 합쳐 어떤 에이전트가 있는지 시각적으로 보여줘야 한다.
웹 UI는 history/ 문서의 날짜별 밀도와 유형별 분포를 시각화해야 한다.
웹 UI는 agent platform/configs/access/view mode registry.json 을 읽어 user , developer , superadmin developer 보기 모드를 선택할 수 있어야 하며, 현재 기본값은 슈퍼어드민 개발 보기여야 한다.
웹 UI는 developer와 superadmin 개발 보기에서 주요 프로젝트와 도구의 소스 코드를 읽기 전용으로 탐색할 수 있어야 한다.
웹 UI는 에이전트들이 어떤 작업 lane에서 움직이고 어떤 task/project와 연결되어 있는지 협업 작업판과 흐름도로 보여줘야 한다.
웹 UI는 운영 대시보드의 밀도와 신뢰를 유지하면서 은근히 귀엽고 조용히 기분 좋은 visual tone을 허용해야 한다.
웹 UI는 agent platform/configs/access/language mode registry.json 을 읽어 전체, 한국어만, 영어만 문서 보기 모드를 선택할 수 있어야 하며 문서/히스토리/요약 카운트에 동일한 언어 렌즈를 적용해야 한다.
웹 UI는 대용량 workspace snapshot을 client JavaScript bundle에 직접 포함하지 않아야 하며, 초기 JS chunk 크기가 성능 예산을 초과하지 않도록 회귀 검사를 제공해야 한다.
정적 export는 HTTP root뿐 아니라 데스크톱 shell, file/subpath 유사 context, repository 서브패스 정적 serving에서도 next asset과 workspace snapshot.json 을 상대 경로로 읽어 주요 대시보드를 렌더링해야 한다.
웹 UI는 분리된 히스토리 기록, 평가, 웹 검색, 작업 시간, 요청 추적, 협업 task/blocker/next action을 unifiedOps 이벤트 stream으로 합쳐 한 화면에서 탐색할 수 있어야 한다.
웹 UI는 view/work/install/language/desktop session/task pipe/CLI adapter/monitor section 모드와 기능을 한 곳에서 명시적으로 보여주고, 각 항목을 어디에서 선택하거나 열 수 있는지 안내해야 한다.
웹 UI는 Overview 상단에서 현재 섹션의 상태, 주의 수준, 다음 행동, 근거 카운트, runtime 바로가기를 한 줄 작업면으로 제공해야 한다.
웹 UI는 히스토리의 최신 사용자 의도 기반 기능 지도를 읽어 의도 수, 기능 축, 구현된 기능, 다음 기능 후보, Now/Next/Later 로드맵, source freshness를 developer/superadmin 보기에서 탐색할 수 있어야 한다.
repository snapshot collector는 기능별 데이터 추출 로직을 명확한 모듈 경계로 분리해, 지속 리팩터링 중에도 동작 보존과 테스트 가능한 책임 경계를 유지해야 한다.
웹 UI는 플랫폼의 운영 메모리, 플랫폼 코어, 데스크톱 제품, 모니터 UI, 도메인 프로젝트, 런타임/로컬 데이터 계층을 한눈에 보여주고 각 계층의 소유 경계, 주요 경로, 금지 경계, 복잡도 압력점을 표시해야 한다.
웹 UI는 핵심 기능 위치를 첫 화면에서 바로 보여주고, 모니터 섹션 탭을 기능군별로 나눠 사용자가 현재 위치와 다음 이동 경로를 즉시 이해할 수 있어야 한다.
웹 UI는 실제 앱처럼 섹션, 보기 모드, 언어 모드, 문서 필터, 주요 action을 전역 command palette와 pinned/recent quick controls로 실행할 수 있어야 한다.
데스크톱 제품 UI는 런타임, task pipe, service readiness, source editor 같은 운영 패널을 좁은 웹 카드처럼 찌그러뜨리지 않고 full width workbench surface로 렌더링해야 하며, 대형 workspace snapshot을 JS fallback chunk로 포함하지 않아야 한다.
데스크톱 source editor는 범용 웹 에디터가 아니라 플랫폼 작업에 맞춘 편집 워크벤치여야 하며, 요구사항/스펙/검증/Tauri command/agent config/decision item 템플릿, 경로 기반 편집 프로필, 패치 컨텍스트 복사를 제공해야 한다.
데스크톱 Source Review는 runtime workspace file index refresh, open editor tab strip, Monaco command toolbar, edit/diff mode, editor settings popup을 제공해 실제 코드 편집 워크벤치로 동작해야 한다.
데스크톱 Source Review는 Source 화면 진입 전 불필요한 runtime source catalog scan을 실행하지 않아야 하며, 파일 목록 렌더링은 중복 리스트와 전체 기본 전개 트리를 피해야 한다.
데스크톱 제품 UI의 반복 액션 버튼, 세그먼트, 툴바, Source/Explorer 컨트롤은 일관된 클릭 타깃 크기를 사용해야 하며, 터치/모바일 환경에서는 더 큰 타깃으로 올라가야 한다.
데스크톱 제품 UI는 전체 화면에서만 동작하는 고정 높이/압축형 배치를 피하고, 핵심 작업을 먼저 보여준 뒤 보조 정보는 접힘/세로 흐름으로 노출해야 한다.
데스크톱 제품 UI의 보이는 기능, 패널, 버튼, workflow step은 한 가지 목적만 명확히 수행해야 하며, 상태/설정/이동/실행/근거 보기를 한 컨트롤이나 패널에 섞지 않아야 한다.
데스크톱 제품 UI는 한 탭에 여러 기능 패널을 얕게 넣지 않아야 하며, 탭이 여러 기능을 담기 시작하면 기본 탭은 선택 메뉴로 낮추고 각 기능은 더 깊은 단일 기능 화면으로 열어야 한다.
